slides.texte_overlay:
Things to learn before your
first serious relationship
How to say what you feel out loud. "I felt hurt when that happened." Calm, clear words like these prevent most fights before they even start, and help her understand you.
How to apologise without excuses. "I was wrong, I'm sorry, here's what I'll do differently." Three simple parts that save a lot of relationships.
How to be happy alone first. A partner should add to your life, not fill a hole in it. Your own friends, hobbies and goals make you a better partner.
How to listen without fixing. Sometimes she needs you to hear her, not solve the problem. Ask "Do you want advice or just someone to listen?"
How to keep growing. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having new things to share keeps conversations alive long after the first months.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. New things to share keep conversations alive for years.

slides.texte_overlay: How to argue fairly. No insults, no bringing up the past, no shouting. Talk about the problem in front of you and look for a solution together.
How to respect her time and space. Her friends, her work, her evenings alone. Trust and freedom make a relationship stronger than constant attention.
